before: An ordered room took a section break on a paragraph mark in a table cell, direct or suggested on its author's own new mark, which the editor alone refuses (setSectionMark). The break wrote a section no read counts, and a later break on the same mark copied the next section's records onto it a second time.
after: The room refuses the break with engine-refused and changes nothing, as the editor alone does.
reason: Change messages, the change log and its kinds keep their meaning, and the Yjs document format and the checkpoint format do not change. Only a change the editor never sends is now refused. An ordered room admits only clients of its own code version.
